main_text.head: PRIMA EXERCITATIO. UTRUM MATERIA ET FORMA SESE mutuò appetant?
main_text.p: Voniam Ioannes Ferne-Cap.ilius initio prioris libri de abditis rerum causis materiam, & formā cor-porum omnium natura-lium principia sese mu-tuò expetere tradit, id-circo in his nos exercere statuimus. page.notes: The woodcut vignette at upper left is an engraved picture of a seated figure and is not transcribed. The initial "V" of "Voniam" is probably the Q of Quoniam, set as printed. The quotation marks "«" in the right margin are reproduced one per line beside the quoted lines, and their exact line positions are approximate. The word "pretiu" and the spelling "difclufæ" are copied as printed; the long s is read as s. The top-right small printer's mark is not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed.
